subject: Literature
subcategory: The Art of the Short Story
title: Boccaccio's Decameron
description: A quick win: understand Boccaccio's Decameron.

hook.text: During the Black Death, ten young people flee to a villa and tell one hundred stories to distract from the horror.

buildup.text: Boccaccio's 1353 Decameron contains tales of love, trickery, and wit told over ten days of quarantine.

discovery.text: The stories mock corrupt priests, foolish husbands, and social conventions with shocking frankness.

twist.text: The book was written during an actual plague, making its pandemic framing devastatingly autobiographical.

climax.text: The Decameron helped establish prose fiction as a literary art and directly inspired Chaucer's Canterbury Tales.

punchline.text: A pandemic inspired one of literature's greatest story collections.

quiz.question: What historical event forms the backdrop of the Decameron?
